title: Rating
summary: Star, heart or circle rating from 1 to 10 with optional labels such as Poor to Excellent, for satisfaction scores and quality checks.
description:
A rating control for any form: customer satisfaction on a support request, a supplier score on a review, a quality grade on an inspection. Pick 2 to 10 stars, hearts or circles, give each value a label (Poor, Fair, Good, Very good, Excellent) and choose whether people can clear their rating.

It behaves like a native radio group: one Tab stop, the arrow keys change the rating, Home and End jump to the ends and Delete clears it. Screen readers announce each symbol as "4 of 5: Very good". The value is a whole number, so workflows can branch on it directly (a Condition on rating < 3 opens a follow-up).

changelog.notes: Dynamic properties: max can be bound to an expression, a data table or an API reference in the form designer (the host resolves them; no network capability needed).
Declares its workflow output: a number.

uses: Customer satisfaction at the end of a support request
Supplier or candidate scoring on a review step
Quality grade on an inspection checklist
setup: Install the package: the control appears in Extensibility → Form controls and in the form designer's palette under Custom.
Drag Rating onto a form, then set the number of symbols, the symbol and the labels in the properties panel.
